metadata.title: Optimizing automated scoring in ILSAs with prompt compression

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variables are binary constructed-response scores, not PV-based cognitive achievement scales.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Recorded evidence does not explicitly establish an unweighted analysis. Original extraction rationale: The study does not report applying PIRLS sampling weights or any replicate-weight variance estimation, indicating that it did not apply weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: There is no information provided about whether the study accounted for school clustering in its analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as accuracy and kappa scores but does not report any validation on external datasets or different countries.

design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): “Across items, Model 3 achieves the highest average accuracy (92.87%)… across 27 countries/29 languages… using a randomly selected 20% subset per country for exploratory analysis.”
design_fields._q2_audit: Corrected not_met to not_reported because original rationale reports absence of weight information or an inference, not direct evidence of unweighted analysis; source verification still required.
